_comment: GENERATED by scripts/build-formulaic-templates.mjs. Templates with one, two or three open slots (a _ c, a _ _ c, a _ _ _ c) that recur more than a within-verse shuffle predicts, with BH control. Records where a pattern recurs, not why; whether it is a formula in the oral-formulaic sense is a scholarly judgment this site does not make.
source: Leeds Quranic Arabic Corpus v0.4 (GPL), diacritic-stripped surface forms, within a verse

method.template: forms a and c a fixed distance apart in one verse (two, three or four words), any words between them; the slot count is the number of words between
method.candidate: support >= 3 windows and >= 2 different slot fillers (the slot words taken together)
method.null: shuffle the words inside every verse (verse lengths and word multisets kept, order destroyed); expected support is the exact mean over shuffles
method.p: Poisson upper tail of the support at that expectation
method.q: Benjamini-Hochberg over all candidates of that width; a system is a candidate with q <= 0.05
method.nullRuns: 100 shuffled copies, mulberry32 seed 20261018, same candidate rule and BH step, each width analyzed on the same copies
method.widthsOverlap: the same pair of fixed words can appear at several widths, and a wider system can contain a narrower one; the widths are separate analyses, not a partition
